# Mirror

![Mirror](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/mirror.png)

Heads: the next coin uses the effects of its other side. Tails: 2 points.

- **Rarity:** Rare
- **Heads chance:** 65%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 1 point, Next coin uses its other side

## Tails
Score 2 points

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Seer](characters-seer)
